snippet.title: The Princess and the Portals Trailer
snippet.description:
The Princess and the Portals is a new puzzle platformer available June 9th exclusively on the Playdate Catalog.

Game created by Pwned and Operated Studios, LLC
Music Arranged by Jeremy Tellock
Music Composed by Nicole Harvey
